title: How B2B Software Companies Should Structure Content Around the Buying Committee
excerpt: Most B2B software content targets one reader and ignores the four to seven people who actually approve the purchase. Here is how to map your content to the whole buying committee.
metaDescription: A practical guide to content marketing for B2B software companies: map content to the buying committee and buyer stages so more deals close faster.

title: How AI Answer Engines Decide Which Sources to Cite
excerpt: ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews all pick a handful of sources per answer. The selection is not random, and it is not the same as ranking first.
metaDescription: AI assistants cite a small number of sources per answer. Here is how that selection actually works, and what makes a page more likely to be one of them.
